title: Updating the copies and power register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $11$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its copies-and-power scratch value by $y$.
replaced:
For a register record and a natural number $y$, updating the entry at index $11$ of its
length-fifteen value vector to $y$ gives the value vector of the record obtained by
replacing the scratch value used for the copies and the power with $y$.
